newsitem.title: UK: Lehman appoints new head of global FX sales.
newsitem.headline: Lehman appoints new head of global FX sales.

text.p: Lehman Brothers appointed J. Howard "Buddy" Carter as executive director, head of global foreign exchange sales, the investment bank said in a statement.
Carter will be based in London and report to John McDonald, head of fixed-income sales.

Carter previously worked at Goldman Sachs for 13 years, where he was head of foreign exchange (Asia), in addition to holding other important positions in both Hong Kong and New York, including head of spot trading in New York. -- London newsroom + 44 171 542 7792
